Design.protocol: AEP — Artifact Exchange Protocol. Follow the exact deployed Protocol artifact; this is an offline explanatory reference.
Design.purpose: Two participants interpret a shared state machine and exchange inline text or artifact references.
Design.application_role: A separate artifact defines authorized operations, payload meaning, defaults and completion criteria.

Deployment.provider: Azure Blob Storage in the tested POC
Deployment.access: Configured by participants; credentials are not part of this reference.
Deployment.write_coordination: Short finite blob lease plus fresh ETag / If-Match for each transition. Release before processing or polling.
Deployment.read_coordination: Reads remain possible while leased. Participants follow the selected protocol.
Deployment.bootstrap: Protocol URL + authorized access + participant/peer + semaphoreResource + roleResource.

fields.protocolVersion: Selected deployed protocol version; both participants must support it.
fields.status: For ABORT: PENDING | ABORTED; normal result success is application-role data.
fields.correlation: Unique exchange identifier, unchanged during its cycle.
fields.lockedBy: Logical exchange owner; this is not Azure lease status.
fields.revision: Increment on each committed semaphore update.
fields.updatedAt: UTC update timestamp; not authority for a takeover.
fields.abortPeer: Participant that must quiesce and acknowledge abort.

rules: Commit referenced input before REQUEST and referenced output before READY.
Capture and verify the required response before ACK. READY is result availability; IDLE after ACK is receipt, not device success.
A lease serializes semaphore writers. It does not make external device side effects exactly-once.
Polling runs within a bounded active session; timeout never fabricates IDLE.
Runtime.evidence: Owner-tested single-request AppLog/device loop and script execution. This Explorer page is an offline reference, not runtime evidence or a live connection.
Runtime.scope: Current POC: one slot, half duplex, two participants. Pools/full duplex/fan-out are proposed protocol extensions.
